Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,

futures.

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

## **Honoring the Life and Legacy of Izzy Schwab **

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

Izzy's leadership, humility, and belief in people helped shape D&H into what it is today, serving
partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

Make-A-Wish
Philadelphia, Delaware & Susquehanna Valley

sentiments will be made available.

## ** D&H Prioritizes Partners **

For more than a century, D&H has always put our partners first. To support their future growth, we
have recently expanded our dedicated sales & support teams, broadened our communities, grown our
solutions portfolio, and invested in our finance, supply chain, and marketing agency services.

**[Discover how D&H is Built for
Growth, Giving, and Generations >>][39]**

## **Honoring the Life and Legacy of Izzy Schwab **

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

Izzy's leadership, humility, and belief in people helped shape D&H into what it is today, serving
partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

[Visit Our Tribute Wall and Share Your Stories][40]

In lieu of flowers, the family has shared that those who wish to honor Izzy's memory may consider
a contribution to either of these two organizations, causes close to his heart.

Make-A-Wish
Philadelphia, Delaware & Susquehanna Valley

[Donate Here][41]

Humane Society of Harrisburg Area/Central PA

[Donate Here][42]

The family will be having a private funeral, however we also plan to host a Celebration of Life at a
future date at D&H Headquarters that will be open to friends, partners, and members of the D&H
community. For those unable to attend in person, additional ways to participate or share
sentiments will be made available.

First International Workshop on

Artificial Intelligence for Accessible XR Experiences and Spatial Systems
(AI-AXESS)

How can artificial intelligence (AI) transform extended reality (XR) into a universally accessible
and adaptive medium? 

Despite advancements in XR technologies, many systems still fail to accommodate users with diverse
needs, such as those with visual, motor, or cognitive impairments. A key challenge lies in enabling
XR systems to dynamically understand and respond to both physical and virtual spaces in real time.
By integrating AI-driven techniques such as machine learning algorithms, computer vision, semantic
mapping, intelligent localization systems, and adaptive interfaces, XR can bridge these gaps,
creating immersive experiences that are inclusive, intuitive, and context-aware. This workshop will
bring together experts in AI, XR, and inclusive design to explore cutting-edge solutions that
empower all users to fully engage with immersive technologies.

In the last decade, AI has emerged as a transformative force across XR applications. Techniques
evolving from earlier computer vision algorithms to current neural networks and large language
models are expanding the possibilities for accessibility in immersive environments. Key advancements
include semantic scene understanding, multimodal interaction processing, and adaptive content
generation, complemented by specialized models for spatial mapping, gesture recognition, and gaze
tracking. Edge AI solutions now enable on-device processing with reduced latency, while federated
learning approaches address privacy concerns through decentralized training. These technologies aim
to make XR interactions more intuitive and adaptive for diverse users. For example, spatial
understanding through object recognition holds potential for assisting navigation for users with
visual impairments, while natural language processing enables flexible interaction methods that
reduce reliance on complex physical controls. Similarly, neural networks for adaptive rendering can
modify visual elements like contrast or highlighting to improve clarity for users with low vision.

Nonetheless, integrating AI into XR is not without its challenges. Current systems often struggle
with balancing real-time performance demands against hardware limitations, particularly in
applications requiring precise localization or adaptive rendering. For example, latency issues can
disrupt seamless navigation for visually impaired users, while insufficient computational resources
may limit the effectiveness of real-time scene interpretation for cognitive or sensory
accessibility. Furthermore, a lack of diverse training datasets often leads to biases in AI models,
reducing their reliability for underrepresented user groups, such as those with atypical speech
patterns or complex motor disabilities. Additionally, ethical considerations around user privacy and
data security are of crucial importance, as accessibility features may rely on sensitive inputs like
gaze or voice. Robust frameworks are needed to ensure responsible data handling. Finally, the rapid
evolution of both AI and XR technologies adds another layer of complexity, requiring accessibility
features to be adaptable and forward-thinking.

We encourage submissions presenting AI-driven or AI-enabled approaches, including early-stage work,
initial analyses, experimental techniques, or position papers summarizing relevant AI-based methods
and experiences. Papers should be 2 to 8 pages. Topics include but are not limited to: 
* AI-driven localization and semantic mapping for accessible navigation
* LLM integration enabling natural language interfaces and contextual assistance
* Multimodal interaction systems (voice, gesture, gaze, haptics) for inclusive control
* Adaptive rendering and content personalization addressing diverse user needs
* AI-assisted 3D content creation and editing supporting accessibility
* Ethical frameworks and privacy-preserving AI methods for XR applications
* Cross-platform standards and interoperability for accessible XR ecosystems
* User-centered design and evaluation methodologies targeting inclusive XR
* Applications of AI within XR for education, healthcare, and social inclusion
* Benchmarking and validation of AI-powered accessibility features
* AI-supported Cognitive load management and simplified interaction paradigms


Important dates

Submission Deadline:
November 21st, 2025 (AoE)

Notification:
December 5th, 2025

Camera Ready:
December 15th, 2025

Workshop Date:
January 26th, 2026 (tentat

First International Workshop on

Artificial Intelligence for Accessible XR Experiences and Spatial Systems
(AI-AXESS)

How can artificial intelligence (AI) transform extended reality (XR) into a universally accessible
and adaptive medium? 

Despite advancements in XR technologies, many systems still fail to accommodate users with diverse
needs, such as those with visual, motor, or cognitive impairments. A key challenge lies in enabling
XR systems to dynamically understand and respond to both physical and virtual spaces in real time.
By integrating AI-driven techniques such as machine learning algorithms, computer vision, semantic
mapping, intelligent localization systems, and adaptive interfaces, XR can bridge these gaps,
creating immersive experiences that are inclusive, intuitive, and context-aware. This workshop will
bring together experts in AI, XR, and inclusive design to explore cutting-edge solutions that
empower all users to fully engage with immersive technologies.

In the last decade, AI has emerged as a transformative force across XR applications. Techniques
evolving from earlier computer vision algorithms to current neural networks and large language
models are expanding the possibilities for accessibility in immersive environments. Key advancements
include semantic scene understanding, multimodal interaction processing, and adaptive content
generation, complemented by specialized models for spatial mapping, gesture recognition, and gaze
tracking. Edge AI solutions now enable on-device processing with reduced latency, while federated
learning approaches address privacy concerns through decentralized training. These technologies aim
to make XR interactions more intuitive and adaptive for diverse users. For example, spatial
understanding through object recognition holds potential for assisting navigation for users with
visual impairments, while natural language processing enables flexible interaction methods that
reduce reliance on complex physical controls. Similarly, neural networks for adaptive rendering can
modify visual elements like contrast or highlighting to improve clarity for users with low vision.

Nonetheless, integrating AI into XR is not without its challenges. Current systems often struggle
with balancing real-time performance demands against hardware limitations, particularly in
applications requiring precise localization or adaptive rendering. For example, latency issues can
disrupt seamless navigation for visually impaired users, while insufficient computational resources
may limit the effectiveness of real-time scene interpretation for cognitive or sensory
accessibility. Furthermore, a lack of diverse training datasets often leads to biases in AI models,
reducing their reliability for underrepresented user groups, such as those with atypical speech
patterns or complex motor disabilities. Additionally, ethical considerations around user privacy and
data security are of crucial importance, as accessibility features may rely on sensitive inputs like
gaze or voice. Robust frameworks are needed to ensure responsible data handling. Finally, the rapid
evolution of both AI and XR technologies adds another layer of complexity, requiring accessibility
features to be adaptable and forward-thinking.

We encourage submissions presenting AI-driven or AI-enabled approaches, including early-stage work,
initial analyses, experimental techniques, or position papers summarizing relevant AI-based methods
and experiences. Papers should be 2 to 8 pages. Topics include but are not limited to: 
* AI-driven localization and semantic mapping for accessible navigation
* LLM integration enabling natural language interfaces and contextual assistance
* Multimodal interaction systems (voice, gesture, gaze, haptics) for inclusive control
* Adaptive rendering and content personalization addressing diverse user needs
* AI-assisted 3D content creation and editing supporting accessibility
* Ethical frameworks and privacy-preserving AI methods for XR applications
* Cross-platform standards and interoperability for accessible XR ecosystems
* User-centered design and evaluation methodologies targeting inclusive XR
* Applications of AI within XR for education, healthcare, and social inclusion
* Benchmarking and validation of AI-powered accessibility features
* AI-supported Cognitive load management and simplified interaction paradigms

# **Augmented Reality QR Code**

## No need for an app.


An AR Code is a type of QR Code that contains the necessary information to generate an Augmented
Reality 3D experience. It operates without the need for a dedicated app on smartphones and AR/VR
headsets like the Apple Vision Pro. Begin creating, managing, and tracking your AR experiences.
[[AR QR Code]][39]


[Get Started][40] [Choose Your Plan][41]

Launch your first AR QR Code experience today.



### Android OS, iOS/iPadOS, Meta Horizon OS, Android XR & visionOS

[[F1 AR QR Code]][42] [[Piston AR QR Code]][43] [[Woman AR QR Code]][44] [[Statue museum AR QR
Code]][45] [[Trex AR QR Code]][46]


## [How to Scan an AR Code?][47]


**An AR Code is designed to be universally rendered without any app on all mobile devices, including
AR/VR headsets.** Immersive AR rendering is supported on iOS, Android OS, visionOS, and Meta Horizon
OS. Even older Android devices will have access to immersive WebAR thanks to our low-power SLAM
rendering technology. Additionally, AR Codes support advanced AR and AI features through our
solutions such as AR Face Filters and AI Codes, enhancing AR experiences across a wide range of
compatible smartphone devices.


[Create Your First AR Code][48]

Fast launch, broad compatibility, and no dedicated app to install.

AR Code technology has the potential to enhance a wide variety of products and materials. By using
AR QR Codes, businesses and organizations can easily add interactive, digital experiences to these
materials, making them more engaging and informative for users.

Integrate AR Codes on packaging for Augmented Reality digital experiences, easily scanned on Android
and iOS devices.

[[AR Code Product Packaging]][50]

Add ARCodes on websites and e-commerce sites for engaging 3D product information or AR Videos.

[[AR Code Websites]][52]

Incorporate AR Codes on signage for interactive content such as product demos and event schedules.

[[AR Code Banners Posters]][54]

### [Flyers & Brochures][55]

Integrate AR Codes for interactive promotions and [Augmented Reality displays in restaurant
menus][56].

[[AR Code Brochures Flyers]][57]

Utilize ARCodes on business cards for quick access to contact information or product details in 3D.

[[AR Code Business Cards]][59]

Include AR QR Codes in publications for interactive content such as AR videos or AR 3D models.

[[AR Code Books]][61]

### Three types of AR rendering

AR Codes can be used to access different types of Augmented Reality rendering, including Immersive
AR, Face Filters AR and AI Assistance AR.

[[immersive AR rendering]][64] [[AR Face Filters]][65] [[AI Code]][66]

## **Immersive AR, Face Filters & AI Experiences**



* Immersive AR: displays AR experiences in your direct environment: 3D models, videos,
  photogrammetric 3D scans,...
  
  
* Face Filters AR: Displays AR Face filters created on the AR Code platform featuring your own image
  or logo.
  
  
* AI Experiences: [AI Code][67]; prompts users to take a photo, which is then analyzed by AI to
  provide personalized responses or advice, creating an individualized augmented reality experience.

**Augmented Reality Codes offer a wide range of possibilities for businesses, organizations, and
individuals to create and share interactive, digital experiences.**

* Enhancing product packaging, signage, and other materials with interactive, [3D digital
  content][68].
* Creating immersive, interactive AR experiences for customers or users, such as virtual tours or
  product demonstrations.
* Providing information and instructions in Augmented Reality.
* Adding AR to games and other entertainment experiences.
* Creating AR marketing campaigns that attract attention and drive engagement.


By using AR Codes, it’s possible to create distinctive and captivating experiences that can enhance
a wide range of products, services, and materials. The concept of accessing augmented reality
content is gaining popularity, especially with the recent launch of the Apple Vision Pro headset.

# **Augmented Reality QR Code**

## No need for an app.


An AR Code is a type of QR Code that contains the necessary information to generate an Augmented
Reality 3D experience. It operates without the need for a dedicated app on smartphones and AR/VR
headsets like the Apple Vision Pro. Begin creating, managing, and tracking your AR experiences.
[[AR QR Code]][39]


[Get Started][40] [Choose Your Plan][41]

Launch your first AR QR Code experience today.



### Android OS, iOS/iPadOS, Meta Horizon OS, Android XR & visionOS

Code]][45] [[Trex AR QR Code]][46]


## [How to Scan an AR Code?][47]


**An AR Code is designed to be universally rendered without any app on all mobile devices, including
AR/VR headsets.** Immersive AR rendering is supported on iOS, Android OS, visionOS, and Meta Horizon
OS. Even older Android devices will have access to immersive WebAR thanks to our low-power SLAM
rendering technology. Additionally, AR Codes support advanced AR and AI features through our
solutions such as AR Face Filters and AI Codes, enhancing AR experiences across a wide range of
compatible smartphone devices.


[Create Your First AR Code][48]

Fast launch, broad compatibility, and no dedicated app to install.

### Add Augmented Reality experiences anywhere

AR Code technology has the potential to enhance a wide variety of products and materials. By using
AR QR Codes, businesses and organizations can easily add interactive, digital experiences to these
materials, making them more engaging and informative for users.

and iOS devices.

### [Books, Guides & Magazines][60]

[[AR Code Books]][61]




AR Code gives your audience instant access to immersive AR content with zero friction. Simply add a

### Three types of AR rendering

AR Codes can be used to access different types of Augmented Reality rendering, including Immersive
AR, Face Filters AR and AI Assistance AR.

[[immersive AR rendering]][64] [[AR Face Filters]][65] [[AI Code]][66]

## **Immersive AR, Face Filters & AI Experiences**



* Immersive AR: displays AR experiences in your direct environment: 3D models, videos,
  photogrammetric 3D scans,...
  
  
* Face Filters AR: Displays AR Face filters created on the AR Code platform featuring your own image
  or logo.
  
  
* AI Experiences: [AI Code][67]; prompts users to take a photo, which is then analyzed by AI to
  provide personalized responses or advice, creating an individualized augmented reality experience.

**Augmented Reality Codes offer a wide range of possibilities for businesses, organizations, and
individuals to create and share interactive, digital experiences.**

Some potential uses for AR QR Codes include:
* Enhancing product packaging, signage, and other materials with interactive, [3D digital

* Creating immersive, interactive AR experiences for customers or users, such as virtual tours or
  product demonstrations.
* Providing information and instructions in Augmented Reality.
* Adding AR to games and other entertainment experiences.
* Creating AR marketing campaigns that attract attention and drive engagement.


By using AR Codes, it’s possible to create distinctive and captivating experiences that can enhance
a wide range of products, services, and materials. The concept of accessing augmented reality
content is gaining popularity, especially with the recent launch of the Apple Vision Pro headset.

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Investing by J.P. Morgan

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Engineering first.
## AI-enhanced

The AI era doesn’t replace engineering fundamentals, but it raises the bar for them. The hard part
is not the demo, but scaling, securing, integrating, and sustaining AI inside real products.
EffectiveSoft brings deep experience in complex systems, production delivery, and
reliability-critical environments.

## Our delivery principles

We own the engineering from early concept to enterprise-scale systems and long-term support.
* PRODUCT-CENTRIC Toggle Item
  
  Ideas do not create value until they reach users. We cover the full path, from definition to
  long-term operation, with one accountable team responsible for speed, reliability, and measurable
  production outcomes.
* AI-MINDED Toggle Item
  
  AI strengthens how we engineer software. It helps us explore ideas faster, eliminate routine

# Trusted by our clients to create captivating & effective digital content since 2001

## [Award-Winning VR, AR & 3D Animation Creators][55]

[Elara Systems: Trusted by our clients to create captivating and effective digital content since
2001][Elara Systems: Trusted by our clients to create captivating and effective digital content
since 2001]

## 3D Animation, XR, and Interactive Services

Interactive Content
[Interactive Content][56]Who is your target audience? Is your content going to be played on multiple
devices or different platforms? Where are you going to show it? These questions are all essential,
not only for you to finalize your deployment strategy, but also to form the foundation for your
initial project build. The more information we are able to obtain on the front end, ensures that
you’re not rebuilding down the road or — as we like to say — wasting money. Check out how the
interactive content we produce for our clients is put to use.[Learn More][57]
3D Animation
[3D Animation][58]Producing photorealistic, vibrant and engaging 3D Animation formed the foundation
of Elara when the company launched in 2001. Our efficient production process ensures that your
content will be delivered on-time and on-budget. Frequent touchpoints with our clients during the
production process ensures that their creative vision is fully realized at final review without any
last minute surprises. With twenty years of experience, we have the requisite skills to produce
content that will put you ahead of your competition in terms of look, message and impact.[Learn
More][59]
Extended Reality
[Extended Reality][60]XR is an umbrella term that refers to VR (Virtual Reality), AR (Augmented
Reality), and MR (Mixed Reality). Incorporation of these technologies across different divisions –
marketing, sales, education, and training – is advancing quickly with businesses of all types and
sizes. We work with our clients strategically to produce engaging and compelling content that not
only stands the test of time, but is scalable and delivers proven ROI. Click here to learn more
about XR and our experience with these technologies.[Learn More][61]
Contact Us
[Contact Us][62]Whether you’re looking to have one animation produced or numerous Virtual Reality
modules, we’ll bring our experience and commitment to excellence to every meeting. Our team is
excited to hear about your project, and hopefully, will help you take it to the next level.[Learn
More][63]
How We Work
[How We Work][64]From start to finish, Elara is focused on delivering exceptional content for our
clients. We make sure that we are aligned with our client’s goals — never over-promising and always
over-delivering. Our proven processes have never let us down.[Learn More][65]
Soft Skills Training
[Soft Skills Training][66]Elara’s immersive content is a game-changer for soft skills training. Its
advanced virtual human animations, conversational interactions, and voice input enable learners to
role-play and develop crucial skills in a safe and engaging environment. The result is better
learning outcomes, including accelerated learning, confidence building, emotional engagement, remote
learning, and measured skills improvement, that traditional video and e-learning can’t match.[Learn
More][67]

# Trusted by our clients to create captivating & effective digital content since 2001

## [Award-Winning VR, AR & 3D Animation Creators][55]

[Elara Systems: Trusted by our clients to create captivating and effective digital content since
2001][Elara Systems: Trusted by our clients to create captivating and effective digital content
since 2001]

## 3D Animation, XR, and Interactive Services

Interactive Content
[Interactive Content][56]Who is your target audience? Is your content going to be played on multiple
devices or different platforms? Where are you going to show it? These questions are all essential,
not only for you to finalize your deployment strategy, but also to form the foundation for your
initial project build. The more information we are able to obtain on the front end, ensures that
you’re not rebuilding down the road or — as we like to say — wasting money. Check out how the
interactive content we produce for our clients is put to use.[Learn More][57]
3D Animation
[3D Animation][58]Producing photorealistic, vibrant and engaging 3D Animation formed the foundation
of Elara when the company launched in 2001. Our efficient production process ensures that your
content will be delivered on-time and on-budget. Frequent touchpoints with our clients during the
production process ensures that their creative vision is fully realized at final review without any
last minute surprises. With twenty years of experience, we have the requisite skills to produce
content that will put you ahead of your competition in terms of look, message and impact.[Learn
More][59]
Extended Reality
[Extended Reality][60]XR is an umbrella term that refers to VR (Virtual Reality), AR (Augmented
Reality), and MR (Mixed Reality). Incorporation of these technologies across different divisions –
marketing, sales, education, and training – is advancing quickly with businesses of all types and
sizes. We work with our clients strategically to produce engaging and compelling content that not
only stands the test of time, but is scalable and delivers proven ROI. Click here to learn more
about XR and our experience with these technologies.[Learn More][61]
Contact Us
[Contact Us][62]Whether you’re looking to have one animation produced or numerous Virtual Reality
modules, we’ll bring our experience and commitment to excellence to every meeting. Our team is
excited to hear about your project, and hopefully, will help you take it to the next level.[Learn
More][63]
How We Work
[How We Work][64]From start to finish, Elara is focused on delivering exceptional content for our
clients. We make sure that we are aligned with our client’s goals — never over-promising and always
over-delivering. Our proven processes have never let us down.[Learn More][65]
Soft Skills Training
[Soft Skills Training][66]Elara’s immersive content is a game-changer for soft skills training. Its
advanced virtual human animations, conversational interactions, and voice input enable learners to
role-play and develop crucial skills in a safe and engaging environment. The result is better
learning outcomes, including accelerated learning, confidence building, emotional engagement, remote
learning, and measured skills improvement, that traditional video and e-learning can’t match.[Learn
More][67]

## [Elara Systems Logo]

[XR Solutions][68] [3D Animations][69] [Interactive Content][70] [Soft Skills][71]

## Follow U

## AI is easy.
## Impact is hard.

That's where HCLTech makes the difference.
We turn AI into measurable business outcomes, from deployment to value and from insight to real
impact.

Our solutions are repeatable by design, responsible by default and engineered for scale. They are
shaped by our people who don't just build AI, but engineer it to deliver business outcomes in the
real world. Because anyone can promise AI. We build it to perform.

[Learn more][143]
[AI Leadership Report]

## The Blueprint for AI Leadership

### It's personal, not just technical

In our **3rd edition of The Blueprint series**, featuring 500 business and IT leaders, we reveal a
widening gap between organizations adopting AI and those realizing meaningful business value.

Only 18% of surveyed organizations say AI is delivering significant revenue impact, exposing a
critical gap between operational progress and business outcomes.

Learn how organizations are navigating the age of GenAI and identify specific shifts in strategy,
culture, data and architecture required to bridge the gap from experimentation to enterprise-wide
leadership.

[Download report][144]
[AI Force 2.0 to deliver enterprise-grade Agentic AI]

## Pioneers of Enterprise AI

### Episode 1 - How CTOs Scale AI and Build AI-Ready Workforces with Pearson

Vijay Guntur, CTO and Head of Ecosystems at HCLTech, joins David Treat, CTO at Pearson to examine
why many AI initiatives fall short of expected returns and what leaders can do differently.

[[Episode 2- Reimagining the future of life sciences]][146]

### Episode 2 - Reimagining the future of life sciences

Kanda Natarajan, VP of IT at GSK, and Vijay Guntur, CTO and Head of Ecosystems at HCLTech, join
Sophia Zhang, SVP at Conde Nast to reflect on their experiences and highlight key lessons for
leaders.

[[Episode 3 - Scaling Enterprise AI beyond pilots]][147]

### Episode 3 - Scaling Enterprise AI beyond pilots

Ulf Axelsson Lejon, VP of Digital Business Transformation, Husqvarna Group and Dr. Mansoor
Samavatian, Technology & Delivery Partner, HCLTech discuss enterprise AI impact with Catherine
Crump, WIRED.

[[Episode 4- Modernizing Enterprise Legacy]][148]

### Episode 4 - Modernizing Enterprise Legacy

Johan Sporre, VP, Technology Foundation, Ericsson and Suresh Deshpande, AVP, HCLTech, discuss the
building blocks required to scale AI effectively with Charlie Burton, Director of Content, WIRED.

[[Episode 5 - Building a Physical AI strategy]][149]

### Episode 5 - Building a Physical AI strategy

In this episode, Rohan Davidson, CIO, Anglo American Group and Deepa Nittur, VP, HCLTech explore how
Physical AI is transforming operations with Catherine Crump from WIRED.

[[Episode 6: The strategic role of a trusted advisor in scaling AI]][150]

Bijoy Sagar, Chief Information and Digital Officer, Bayer and Pankaj Tagra, Chief Growth Officer,

We turn AI into measurable business outcomes, from deployment to value and from insight to real
impact.

Our solutions are repeatable by design, responsible by default and engineered for scale. They are
shaped by our people who don't just build AI, but engineer it to deliver business outcomes in the
real world. Because anyone can promise AI. We build it to perform.

## The Blueprint for AI Leadership

### It's personal, not just technical

In our **3rd edition of The Blueprint series**, featuring 500 business and IT leaders, we reveal a
widening gap between organizations adopting AI and those realizing meaningful business value.

Only 18% of surveyed organizations say AI is delivering significant revenue impact, exposing a
critical gap between operational progress and business outcomes.

Learn how organizations are navigating the age of GenAI and identify specific shifts in strategy,
culture, data and architecture required to bridge the gap from experimentation to enterprise-wide
leadership.

**Scalable Strategy**

Build on a future-proof foundation that lets you add new apps and devices anytime.

**Unmatched Performance**

XR streaming enables high-end visual effects by rendering externally and sending only pixels to the
headset.

**Uncompromised Data Security**

Thanks to XR streaming, your data never leaves your infrastructure and is never stored or processed
on the headset.

**Zero Friction Rollout**

Easy access for users, easy oversight and maintenance for IT, all through one centralized platform.

## YOUR POSSIBILITIES
## Manage, Host and Stream Apps to AR and VR Devices

#### Enterprise XR Streaming

With Hololight's XR pixel-streaming technology, the headset only acts as a display, while all
processing stays on your workstation. This allows you to work with complex 3D models smoothly across
all major AR and VR devices.

[Hololight Stream connecting an Apple Vision Pro with Autodesk VRED, demonstrating that Hololight
lets you stream XR apps to any major AR or VR device.]

#### **Central Orchestration Platform**

Hololight Hub is your central XR streaming platform to deploy and manage all streamed applications
in one place. Add both in-house developed XR apps and third-party apps to your catalog, assign
access to users, and let them launch the apps from their account with one click.

[Centrally manage and distribute all AR and VR apps with the Platform Hololight Hub.]

#### **3D Viewer **

Hololight provides a fully integrated 3D Viewer that lets you visualize your 3D models at 1:1 scale
and original complexity without time consuming data preparation.

[Easily drag and drop 3D files into Hololight Space to view and work with them in XR.]

## OUR MISSION
## Enterprise XR Infrastructure Built to Last

Hololight operates from a belief that XR will only reach its potential in enterprise when the

building for **durability** over novelty, **security by default** rather than as an afterthought,

## FAQ
## XR and VR Streaming Basics for Enterprises
* [
  
  #### What is XR (Extended Reality)?
  
  ][77]
  
  **Extended Reality (XR)** is an umbrella term for immersive technologies such as **Virtual Reality
  (VR)**, **Augmented Reality (AR)**, and **Mixed Reality (MR)**. The goal is to merge digital
  content with the real world or to create entirely virtual environments.
* [
  
  #### What is VR (Virtual Reality)?
  
  ][78]
  
  **Virtual Reality (VR)** places users in a completely digital environment. With specialized VR
  headsets such as the **HTC Vive**, **Meta Quest 3**, or **PICO** devices, users can immerse
  themselves in virtual worlds that fully replace the real world.
* [
  
  #### What is AR (Augmented Reality)?
  
  ][79]
  
  **Augmented Reality (AR)** enhances the real world with digital content that is overlaid in real
  time. Well-known examples include the **Microsoft HoloLens** or AR features on modern smartphones.
* [
  
  #### What is VR streaming in an enterprise context?
  
  ][80]
  
  VR streaming refers to rendering VR applications on external infrastructure (cloud or servers) and
  sending the resulting high-quality visuals to headsets over a network.
  
  In enterprise XR deployments this supports larger models, consistent performance, and secure
  centralized control while reducing device constraints.
  
  
  [Learn more about Hololight's XR Streaming Technology][81]
* [
  
  #### Why do AR and VR apps need streaming?
  
  ][82]
  
  AR/VR streaming lets you run 3D applications on powerful external hardware instead of relying on
  the limited performance power of a headset.
  
  In essence, the device only acts as a screen, as all heavy processing happens in your controlled
  environment, and only pixels are sent to the device. This means you can use complex models without
  data preparation, keep sensitive information off the device, support all major AR/VR headsets, and
  scale XR across your organization with consistent performance and easier IT management.
  
  
  [Learn more about Hololight's XR Streaming Technology][83]
* [
  
  #### How does Hololight enable AR and VR streaming?
  
  ][84]
  Hololight uses its proprietary streaming technology to pixel-stream AR and VR applications from
  external hardware to all major AR and VR headsets.
  As the core pillar of your enterprise XR strategy, this approach makes deployments device-agnostic
  and future-proof, while keeping sensitive data secure by ensuring only images are streamed and
  application data remains within controlled infrastructure.
  
   
  
  [Learn more about Hololight's XR Streaming Technology][85]
* [
  
  #### Which headsets are available?
  
  ][86]
  
  There is a wide variety of AR/VR headsets on the market today, designed for different use cases,
  and new ones are continuously being released. Here is a selection of currently available XR
  devices, all of which are supported by our [streaming technology][87]:
  * **Meta Quest family** – with passthrough functionality to view digital content in the real
    world.
  * **PICO 4 Ultra **– VR headset for enterprises and consumers.
  * **HTC Vive family **– powerful VR headsets for gaming and enterprise applications.
  * **Microsoft HoloLens 2 **– headset for AR scenarios.
  * **Apple Vision Pro** – high-end headset with AR and VR support.

# Mazer Trainer

Immerse.
Train.
Repeat.

**Train faster with immersive VR scenarios, AI roleplay avatars, and mobile follow-up practice.**

Mazer Trainer turns training into practice.


Your team practices difficult conversations with AI avatars in VR — then continues short follow-up
exercises on mobile.

##### ****Immersive VR training****

Practice real situations in interactive virtual environments.

##### **AI roleplay avatars**

Use AI-powered characters for realistic conversations, roleplay, and
soft skills practice.

##### ****Mobile follow-up practice****

After the VR session, learners continue practice on their phone with
a familiar AI avatar that checks in on progress.

##### ****Multiuser sessions****

Bring participants, trainers, and teams into
the same virtual space at the same time.

##### **Experience Mazer World for Free**

**Download the Mazer app and step into immersive virtual spaces.
Connect, collaborate, and explore like never before!**

Choose your platform and **download Mazer World app**.

70% Cost Savings and 
80% Time Reduction with VR Training!

**Explore Mazer’s Cutting-Edge Features**

Achieve 90% Faster Rollout of Training Across Departments with VR.

The only tool with Unlimited Monthly Users, for a Fixed Price!

[Download Mazer On Your Device][24]

Mazer Trainer vs Competition

Choosing the right VR training platform is crucial for the success of your training programs. Our
comparison table shows how Mazer Trainer excels with unmatched features.

[[Mazer Trainer vs Competition]][25]*Click on image to zoom in.*

VR learners were

Faster to train than in the classroom
More confident to apply skills learned after training
More emotionally connected to content than classroom learners
More focused than e-learning peers

**PwC VR Soft Skills Training Efficacy Study, 2020**

Your 360° Training Space

[Mazer Trainer][26] is the **first VR Training Creator** that offers you the ability to select the
tools and spaces needed to facilitate meetings, company training sessions, or coaching. We’ve
designed a dedicated space called “Dome360” where you can utilize 180 or 360-degree videos as your
training environment. Simply add your questions and set a timeframe for answers, and you’re all set
**to launch your first 360 training session**!

[Find Out More][27]

Mazer Trainer Calculator

**Estimate the implementation cost** of Mazer Trainer in your company by comparing the average
expenses of traditional training to virtual training, and evaluate the return on investment (ROI).

[Pricing][28]

Access a 72 hour free demo of Mazer Trainer to explore the limitless possibilities it offers!

[Get Started][29]

## Mazer Enterprise

Mazer Trainer is only a small fraction of Mazer’s capabilities. We offer a broad spectrum of custom
VR solutions for clients who need more.

**Mazer is a leading XR/VR business solutions provider **specializing in crafting bespoke [virtual
spaces][30] and scenarios for a diverse range of industries including financial, medical, IT,
technology, and business. Our portfolio showcases innovative projects like a virtual datacenter
designed for technical training and meetings, an educational game for Polish schools, and a [virtual
digital twin][31] of the iconic Rotunda PKO in Warsaw, Poland. And many more.

Mazer Platform

We pride ourselves on developing and maintaining our own Mazer Plaftorm. This unique approach
ensures resilience against global disruptions and grants us independence in project creation. 

Custom Development

We carefully plan and analyze our custom projects with clients first, and then with our team. This
way, we make sure we meet expectations and create projects that truly reflect the real environment.

Support

We will support you on your journey to implement **XR solutions** in your company, providing
comprehensive technical support every step of the way.

# Delivering Next.

NAGASE

We help you **identify**, **develop**, and **expand **new business opportunities in the material
sciences with solutions that drive value and contribute to a sustainable future.

See our brand vision come to life. Company Video
[close button icon]

## Solve Your Biggest Challenges

Deep Expertise

Meet your toughest project requirements by taking advantage of our experience in multidisciplinary
material sciences and technologies.

[ Our Company ][149]
Continuous Innovation

Create new technologies and products through our innovative manufacturing, processing, R&D, and
supply chain capabilities.

[ Innovation ][150]
Global Reach

Bring your products to market faster and more efficiently using our extensive global network, local
market knowledge, and worldwide logistics systems.

[ Global Network ][151]

## Discover Industry Insights & Products

##### We Are in the Business of Innovation

We unlock new value for our customers through an open approach to innovation. As a Business
Designer, we identify untapped opportunities, utilize our diverse resources to develop those
opportunities, and leverage our global network to expand into new markets and regions.

[ Learn More ][160]
Formulation

Get one step closer to your next successful product with our advanced formulation capabilities,
equipment, and expertise.

[ Learn More ][161]
Manufacturing

Bring your ideas to life with our core manufacturing technologies in organic synthesis, enzymatic
reactions, blending, and other cutting-edge niche areas.

[ Learn More ][162]
Distribution and Logistics

Get your products where they need to go with our full-service distribution and logistics services,
including transportation, storage, and customs handling.

[ Learn More ][163]
Product Development

Develop new materials and customized solutions using our specialized equipment for raw materials
analysis and application development.

[ Learn More ][164]
Supply Chain

Through our diversified global distribution network and regional expertise, we are able to source
the products you need, respond to market conditions, and provide continuity of supply.

[ Learn More ][165]
Regulatory Compliance

Take advantage of our global insights when it comes to compliance, certifications, and region
regulations in order to ensure your supplies and materials arrive when and where you need them.

[ Learn More ][166]

#### Contact us to learn about our full product offering.

[ Contact Us ][167]
[ ]

##### Innovation

NAGASE combines its trading company functions with manufacturing, research, biotechnology, and
digital transformation capabilities to create businesses in collaboration with partners, aiming for
a warm and promising future.
[ Learn more ][168]
Future Co-Creation Room

The Future Co-Creation Room was established in April 2017 to drive innovation within the NAGASE
Group and create new value as the core of future business. As of the 2023 fiscal year, it has taken
over new businesses in the medical and energy sectors that were previously being developed by the
business division.

[ Learn More ][169]
NAGASE Biotech Office

Biotechnology is gaining attention as a core innovation that balances the resolution of global
social challenges with economic growth. In particular, "manufacturing using microorganisms"
represents an area where Japan holds a competitive edge, exemplified by its advanced fermentation
technology.

[ Learn More ][170]
Nagase Application Workshop (NAW)

NAGASE Application Workshop (NAW), responsible for testing and evaluating plastics and coatings,
collaborates closely with customers to develop new compounds, molded products, and coatings for
material manufacturers and processing companies.

[ Learn More ][171]
Nagase Bio-Innovation Center

The Nagase Bioinnovation Center is dedicated to addressing social and environmental challenges
through research and evaluating opportunities for solutions. Through our relentless study of
microorganisms, enzymes, and enzyme reactions, we develop sustainable materials to help tackle the
world's most pressing issues.

[ Learn More ][172]
[

# Biomass SAP @ INDEX 26

][174]
In The News

Biomass SAP arrives in Geneva — a starch-based, biodegradable super absorbent polymer engineered to
replace petroleum-based SAP in sanitary pads and light incontinence products, without compromising
performance.

[ Learn More ][175]

# Eastman Tritan™

][177]
Featured

Engineered in the USA, Tritan™ from Eastman combines the crystal clarity of glass and the long
lasting durability of plastic — helping manufacturers and OEMs across Asia create high-quality, and
eco-friendly products, from reusable bottles to premium tableware and small appliances.

##### We Are in the Business of Innovation

We unlock new value for our customers through an open approach to innovation. As a Business
Designer, we identify untapped opportunities, utilize our diverse resources to develop those
opportunities, and leverage our global network to expand into new markets and regions.

[ Learn More ][160]
Formulation

Get one step closer to your next successful product with our advanced formulation capabilities,
equipment, and expertise.

[ Learn More ][161]
Manufacturing

Bring your ideas to life with our core manufacturing technologies in organic synthesis, enzymatic
reactions, blending, and other cutting-edge niche areas.

[ Learn More ][162]
Distribution and Logistics

Get your products where they need to go with our full-service distribution and logistics services,
including transportation, storage, and customs handling.

[ Learn More ][163]
Product Development

Develop new materials and customized solutions using our specialized equipment for raw materials
analysis and application development.

[ Learn More ][164]
Supply Chain

Through our diversified global distribution network and regional expertise, we are able to source
the products you need, respond to market conditions, and provide continuity of supply.

[ Learn More ][165]
Regulatory Compliance

Take advantage of our global insights when it comes to compliance, certifications, and region
regulations in order to ensure your supplies and materials arrive when and where you need them.

##### Innovation

NAGASE combines its trading company functions with manufacturing, research, biotechnology, and
digital transformation capabilities to create businesses in collaboration with partners, aiming for
a warm and promising future.
[ Learn more ][168]
Future Co-Creation Room

The Future Co-Creation Room was established in April 2017 to drive innovation within the NAGASE
Group and create new value as the core of future business. As of the 2023 fiscal year, it has taken
over new businesses in the medical and energy sectors that were previously being developed by the
business division.

[ Learn More ][169]
NAGASE Biotech Office

Biotechnology is gaining attention as a core innovation that balances the resolution of global
social challenges with economic growth. In particular, "manufacturing using microorganisms"
represents an area where Japan holds a competitive edge, exemplified by its advanced fermentation
technology.

[ Learn More ][170]
Nagase Application Workshop (NAW)

NAGASE Application Workshop (NAW), responsible for testing and evaluating plastics and coatings,
collaborates closely with customers to develop new compounds, molded products, and coatings for
material manufacturers and processing companies.

[ Learn More ][171]
Nagase Bio-Innovation Center

The Nagase Bioinnovation Center is dedicated to addressing social and environmental challenges
through research and evaluating opportunities for solutions. Through our relentless study of
microorganisms, enzymes, and enzyme reactions, we develop sustainable materials to help tackle the
world's most pressing issues.

# PIXO Immersive Training Platform

WE MAKE TRAINING A WINNING REALITY

The Problem

## Traditional training can’t scale, measure, or prove readiness

Typical training is outdated and ineffective — relying on static presentations and passive online
modules. Today’s workforce expects modern, mobile learning experiences: **62% of Generation Z prefer

### QBurst Regional Head on the Middle East’s Retail Playbook

This regional feature spotlights Shivkumar Subramaniam, Head - Middle East, as he outlines the
digital evolution of one of the world's most dynamic luxury markets. This conversation comes on the
heels of QBurst’s strategic partnership with XY Retail, a collaboration designed to help Middle
Eastern luxury retailers overcome their legacy tech debt and unify their commerce operations. The
Middle East has become one of the world's most important luxury retail markets. What makes this
region unique? In the three decades that I’ve lived and worked here, I’ve seen Dubai evolve from a
regional trading hub into one of the world's leading luxury retail destinations. It is a remarkable
transformation that has been built through vision, investment, infrastructure, and a relentless
focus on customer experience. One of the things that sets this region apart is its reach. Customers
travel here specifically to shop, arriving from across the GCC, the wider Middle East, the Indian
subcontinent, Africa, and increasingly Central Asia. On any given day, a store in Dubai may serve
customers from several continents within a few hours. The customers—who include affluent residents,
high-spending visitors, and a young, digitally connected generation with strong brand awareness—are
among the most well-travelled consumers in the world and benchmark their experiences against
destinations such as Paris, Milan, Tokyo, and London. As a result, expectations extend well beyond
the product itself. Customers expect personalization, exclusivity, convenience, and seamless
experiences across both physical and digital channels. For these reasons, I no longer view the
Middle East as simply an important luxury market. The combination of global consumer traffic,
cultural diversity, strong purchasing power, tourism-led demand, and an unwavering focus on customer
experience has made it one of the most important growth markets for luxury brands globally and a
region where many retail innovations are now being tested and scaled. What led QBurst and XY Retail
to partner in the Middle East? The partnership reflects where retail is heading and what retailers
in this region keep asking for. Over the years, I have watched them invest heavily in customer
experience, digital channels, loyalty, and omnichannel. The vision is rarely the problem. The hard
part is connecting it to the operations, systems, data, and processes that make it work. Retailers
want to modernize without adding complexity, with visibility across the business, a consistent
experience across channels, the ability to scale, and above all, real outcomes rather than another
technology rollout. That is where this partnership fits. XY Retail brings deep expertise in luxury
retail and unified commerce, and QBurst brings strength in digital engineering, cloud, integration,
data, and AI. And we know what it takes to execute at scale. QBurst recently delivered a large-scale
loyalty transformation for one of the region's leading conglomerates, bringing more than 70 brands
across the GCC onto a single cloud-native platform. We built real-time synchronization between POS,
CRM, and payment systems, allowing them to onboard millions of customers seamlessly. That is what
excites me here. XY Retail's retail expertise, paired with QBurst's ability to engineer, integrate,
and scale complex ecosystems, means we can help retailers close the gap between strategy and
execution, which is where real transformation actually happens. Despite significant investments in
customer experience, many luxury brands still struggle to deliver seamless journeys. Why? The
biggest issue is that customer experience and operational systems often evolve separately. A brand
may invest heavily in digital experiences, loyalty programs, or personalization initiatives. But
when a customer walks into a store, the associate still doesn't have access to a complete view of
that customer. Inventory data may sit in one system, customer data in another, and order history
somewhere else. We recently addressed this issue for a global luxury fashion house. Their fashion
advisors were highly skilled, but their tools only provided fragmented client data. We transformed

# All-in-one bookmark manager

#### Intuitive. Powerful. Runs everywhere

[Open app][8][Download app][9]

## Designed for ✐ creatives, built for {coders}

#### Raindrop.io is the best place to keep all your favorite books, songs, articles or whatever else
#### you come across while browsing.

> We're not trying to reinvent the wheel; we're working on a tool that does everything you expect
> from a **modern bookmark manager**.

## Organize with ease

> Raindrop.io is not just a pretty interface, it can help you untangle your bookmarks mess.

Collections

Group related bookmarks within the same context. Thousands of predefined icons. [Learn more][10]

Tags & filters

Add tags to classify items. Search efficiently by type, tags, or domain. [Learn more][11]

Duplicates and broken links

Keep it clean. We help you find duplicates and pages that are no longer accessible. [Learn more][12]

## See the big picture

> All relevant info about bookmarks visible at a glance, so you can find anything fast.

Highlights

Annotate web and easily revisit key passages in the future. [Learn more][13]

Instant preview

Read articles, view videos, and browse the web without ever leaving your library. [Learn more][14]

Multiple views

View bookmarks the way you like. We have Grid, Headlines, Masonry, or List view modes. [Learn
more][15]

## Connect to your world

> Want to automatically save your X (Twitter) or Youtube favs? Need more complex integration?
> 
> We've covered all use-cases.
> 
> [Integrations][16][API][17]

## Full-text search

> The entire content of every web-page, PDF, and even YouTube video you've saved is fully searchable
> — down to every spoken word.
> 
> Look deeper beyond titles and tags.
> 
> [Learn more…][18]

## We've got your backup

> We automatically create copies of all web-pages and files in your collection.

Web archive

Even if a page you've saved is taken down, you'll still have a copy of it. [Learn more][19]

Dropbox & Google Drive

Save another backup to your cloud drive. [Learn more][20]

## Designed to be personal. Great for teamwork

> Enable access to your collection by coworkers, family or the entire web.

Edit together

Permissions let you control who can access each of your collections. [Learn more][21]

Public page

Share individual collections with the entire web. Sign-up is not required. [Learn more][22]

## Safe & secure

> SSL everywhere, 100% cloud-based architecture secured behind a VPC.
> 
> We keep your data safe, never sold.
> No ads & trackers. Open-source apps.
> 
> [Security & privacy][23][ Github][24]

## No limits.
## Starting from $0

> Unlimited bookmarks, collections, and devices.
> Free to use indefinitely. Upgrade for premium features.
> 
> [Compare plans][25]

## Access even outside of the browser

> Raindrop.io is available as [Chrome][26], [Firefox][27], [Safari][28], and [Edge][29] extension.
> But we also have, [Windows][30], [Mac][31], [iPad][32], [iPhone][33], and [Android][34] app.
> 
> Access your bookmarks seamlessly **across all your devices**.

## But wait, there's more

Reminders

Add reminders and notifications to your bookmarks.

Batch processing

Add tags, move or remove multiple items at once.

Manual sorting

Arrange items in whatever way makes sense for your project.

Upload media & files

All common file types, including PDFs, images, and videos.

Import & Export

Move-in or move out from Raindrop.io at any time you want.

Themes

Light or dark, your choice.

Merge tags

Keep your tags tidy by merging similar ones.

[It’s time to be a hero and join the PJ Masks: Power Heroes for another moonlit adventure! Dash
through the city, avoiding obstacles and defeat the Night-time Baddies!][29]

[MORE NEWS][30]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [CLODS WALLUP GOES LIVE!][31]

[Scary Beasties brand new game, Clods Wallup, is out now. Avoid traps, work magic and steer clear of
the mouths of hungry Wallups as you guide your beloved Clods to safety over 144 fiendish
levels!][32]

[MORE NEWS][33]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [RICKY ZOOM NOMINATED FOR KIDSCREEN AWARD!][34]

[Scary Beasties is delighted that their Ricky Zoom: Welcome to Wheelford app, developed for
Entertainment One, has been nominated for a Kidscreen Award!][35]

[MORE NEWS][36]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [FROZEN 2 AR – AN ENCHANTED ADVENTURE!][37]

[Scary Beasties’ new Frozen 2 Augmented Reality app has launched! Collect portraits of your
favourite Frozen 2 friends, and find crystals to release magical powers, so you can be just like
Elsa!][38]

[MORE NEWS][39]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [EXPLORE A GALAXY FAR FAR AWAY WITH STAR WARS AR][40]

[Explore the Star Wars Galaxy with our free Star Wars Holoscanner Augmented Reality app. Become an
operative for the Resistance, pilot the Millennium Falcon, fight battle droids on Geonosis, control
an AT-ST in combat and much more.][41]

[MORE NEWS][42]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [LEARN TO CODE WITH PJ MASKS: HERO ACADEMY][43]

[Developed for Entertainment One][44][, Scary Beasties’ latest app “PJ Masks: Hero Academy” teaches
STEAM learning through the fundamentals of coding, with its fun and exciting gameplay, stories and
animated action!][45]

[MORE NEWS][46]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [TOYS COME TO LIFE WITH OUR TOY STORY AR APP][47]

[Scary Beasties’ new Toy Story Augmented Reality app has launched, bringing the Woody’s Augmented
Reality Adventure book to life. It’s an AR adventure to infinity… and beyond!][48]

[MORE NEWS][49]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [BEASTIES WIN KIDSCREEN LEARNING APP AWARD!][50]

[We are delighted to announce that our Hey Duggee: The Counting Badge app has won the Kidscreen Best
Branded Learning App award in the preschool category. Congratulations to all the team and massive
thanks to our development partners, Studio AKA and BBC Studios.][51]

[MORE NEWS][52]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [GHOSTKEEPER’S JOURNAL WINS FUTUREBOOK AWARD!][53]

[The Ghostkeeper’s Journal and Field Guide, one of Scary Beastie’s Augmented Reality app projects
for Carlton Books, has won the FutureBookLive FutureBook of the Year award! Congratulations to
Carlton and all the Scary Beasties team.][54]

[MORE NEWS][55]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [2ND BAFTA WIN FOR THE BEASTIES!][56]

[Our Hey Duggee: The Counting Badge app has taken home a 2018 Children’s BAFTA, winning in the
Digital category. Huge thanks to BBC Studios, Studio AKA and BAFTA – Duggee hugs all round!][57]

[MORE NEWS][58]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [NICKELODEON MUSIC LAB LAUNCHES!][59]

[Developed in HTML5 for Nickelodeon, Music Lab is a suite of games that allows you to collect the
essential components for making tunes and music videos: a memorable melody, cracking vocals, a
thumping beat, awesome sound effects and above all a great performance.][60]

[MORE NEWS][61]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [JURASSIC WORLD AR – RAPTOR RESCUE!][62]

[Return to Jurassic World with our official Augmented Reality app for Universal Studios’ new
blockbuster movie Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. With all-new AR dinosaurs that will blow your
mind, this app accompaniment to the Carlton book is a must-have for every Jurassic World fan.][63]

[MORE NEWS][64]


## ABOUT US

We are Scary Beasties, a multi BAFTA award-winning digital creative agency dedicated to the design
and development of online, mobile and AR games. From a game’s initial concept, through to its
design, build and launch, our committed team of creatives and developers has been producing
market-leading digital solutions for our clients since 2007.

## MOBILE GAMES

Using the latest mobile technologies we develop 2D and 3D games for both Android and iOS to maximise
coverage of the smartphone and tablet markets.

## AUGMENTED REALITY

Mixing the real world with the digital, we create cutting edge mobile experiences that push the
boundaries of AR interactivity.

## ONLINE GAMES

From viral mini-games to immersive game-worlds, we tailor bespoke solutions in HTML5 to reach and
engage our clients’ target audiences.

#### RESEARCH  >  CONCEPT  >  DESIGN  >  BUILD  >  TEST  >  DELIVERY

people to meet. Music clubs, roleplaying communities, virtual cinemas and more. Second Life is
always wonderful, sometimes weird, and 100% wow-worthy.

tools. Start learning, building, and innovating through our growing Creation Portal.

decor, and more. Create and monetize your own creations to earn real profits in a virtual economy

THE PREMIER AVANT-GARDE
XR EVENT IN EUROPE

Maison de la Poste
Brussels, Belgium
STEREOPSIA BECOMES UNITED XR EUROPE
8-9-10 DECEMBER 2025

[**United XR Europe**][29] replaces AWE EU and Stereopsia Europe, building on the combined 32 years
of success and leadership of the co-producers in the XR industry. United XR Europe merges the best
of** AWE’s world-renowned exhibition, **from XR giants to promising startups, and influential tech
leaders with **Stereopsia’s prestigious conference programming**, deep industry insights, visionary
workshops, and long-standing connection with European institutions and initiatives (XR4Europe, XR
Valley, Women In Immersive Tech Europe). Together, they are creating a mega event at the heart of
Europe redefining XR industry standards while highlighting the strategic importance of
public-private partnerships and ethics in advancing Europe’s XR leadership.

[ GO TO UNITED XR EUROPE ][30]

###### Shaping Tomorrow's Realities

**Stereopsia is more than an event**; it’s a catalyst for redefining human experiences through
eXtended Reality (XR). As **Europe’s foremost** **XR event**, Stereopsia ignites creativity and
innovation in an energetic, collaborative setting. With its roots in the 3D revolution of
yesteryears (the event started in 2009!), Stereopsia remains at the forefront of technological
evolution, steadfast in its commitment to pioneering research and innovation. At its core,
Stereopsia fosters collaboration and cross-pollination among diverse audiences, driving XR adoption
across Europe and beyond. Located strategically in **Brussels**, at the heart of European
innovation, Stereopsia offers a panoramic view of the XR landscape, shaping the future of immersive
technologies continent-wide.

###### Three Themes, Diverse Audiences:
###### Stereopsia's Multifaceted Approach

Stereopsia offers **three** **days** packed with engaging activities and thought-provoking
discussions. Check it out below:

[DAY 1 - EUROPEAN PERSPECTIVES][31]

The first day delves into discussions on European topics shaping the XR landscape.

[DAY 2 - TECH, INDUSTRY & SCIENCE][32]

The second day explores the latest advancements in XR technology, industry trends, and insights from
end-users. You’ll also find the Academic track with scientific presentations on applied science.

[DAY 3 - ART & ENTERTAINMENT][33]

The third day sits at the intersection of culture, heritage, art, futurism, and entertainment.   **
**

###### Unveiling the Highlights

But wait, there’s more. While Stereopsia is primarily a **knowledge-sharing event**, it offers so
much more.
Experience our exceptional **match-making** B2B opportunities, delve into our two **accelerators**
catering to XR projects and startups, witness the prestige of the European XR Awards® with
outstanding AR and VR European contents are recognized, and explore exclusive **demo areas**
showcasing the latest in XR tech and content.
Join us for an unforgettable journey at Stereopsia, where innovation knows no bounds.

Stereopsia EUROPE also hosts an Exhibition area at the very center of its venue with XR demos and
the XR showcase with the nominated VR & AR content.

#####    **
##### **

###### BIG THANKS TO OUR SPONSORS AND PARTNERS!

#### OUR Sponsors and Partners

#### WHO's ATTENDing STEREOPSIA?

###### event album

#### [Photo Gallery.][34]

###### event video

#### AFTERMOVIE 2024.

[[Stereopsia]][35]

Stereopsia, Europe’s foremost avant-garde XR event, situated in the vibrant heart of the continent,
offers an annual exploration of the XR ecosystem. Dive into enlightening conferences, captivating
keynotes, immersive XR demos, and unparalleled B2B opportunities. The EMIC market is supported by
the MEDIA Program of Europe Creative.

**SAVE THE DATE: 8-10 December 2025 (Brussels, Belgium).**

Menu

* [FAQ][38]

*We respect the confidential nature of your personal data. We do not send to third parties the email
addresses of those who subscribe to this newsletter. You can unsubscribe from it at any time.*

of success and leadership of the co-producers in the XR industry. United XR Europe merges the best

workshops, and long-standing connection with European institutions and initiatives (XR4Europe, XR
Valley, Women In Immersive Tech Europe). Together, they are creating a mega event at the heart of
Europe redefining XR industry standards while highlighting the strategic importance of
public-private partnerships and ethics in advancing Europe’s XR leadership.

[ GO TO UNITED XR EUROPE ][30]

###### Shaping Tomorrow's Realities

**Stereopsia is more than an event**; it’s a catalyst for redefining human experiences through
eXtended Reality (XR). As **Europe’s foremost** **XR event**, Stereopsia ignites creativity and
innovation in an energetic, collaborative setting. With its roots in the 3D revolution of
yesteryears (the event started in 2009!), Stereopsia remains at the forefront of technological
evolution, steadfast in its commitment to pioneering research and innovation. At its core,
Stereopsia fosters collaboration and cross-pollination among diverse audiences, driving XR adoption
across Europe and beyond. Located strategically in **Brussels**, at the heart of European
innovation, Stereopsia offers a panoramic view of the XR landscape, shaping the future of immersive
technologies continent-wide.

###### Three Themes, Diverse Audiences:
###### Stereopsia's Multifaceted Approach

Stereopsia offers **three** **days** packed with engaging activities and thought-provoking
discussions. Check it out below:

[DAY 1 - EUROPEAN PERSPECTIVES][31]

The first day delves into discussions on European topics shaping the XR landscape.

[DAY 2 - TECH, INDUSTRY & SCIENCE][32]

The second day explores the latest advancements in XR technology, industry trends, and insights from
end-users. You’ll also find the Academic track with scientific presentations on applied science.

[DAY 3 - ART & ENTERTAINMENT][33]

The third day sits at the intersection of culture, heritage, art, futurism, and entertainment.   **
**

###### Unveiling the Highlights

But wait, there’s more. While Stereopsia is primarily a **knowledge-sharing event**, it offers so
much more.
Experience our exceptional **match-making** B2B opportunities, delve into our two **accelerators**
catering to XR projects and startups, witness the prestige of the European XR Awards® with
outstanding AR and VR European contents are recognized, and explore exclusive **demo areas**
showcasing the latest in XR tech and content.
Join us for an unforgettable journey at Stereopsia, where innovation knows no bounds.

Stereopsia EUROPE also hosts an Exhibition area at the very center of its venue with XR demos and
the XR showcase with the nominated VR & AR content.

Trinus turns your Google Cardboard, Daydream or Sony PSVR into a PC VR headset for SteamVR.

## Wolvic is the independent, open source XR web browser.

Browse the web, watch videos, play immersive games and more.

[Downloads][6]

## Why Wolvic?
* XR First
  
  With a custom browser UX, Wolvic is built for XR experiences and rethinks content interaction in
  ways that make sense for XR.
* Productivity
  
  Stay productive with support for multiple windows, tabs, extensions, sync with Desktop and
  external keyboards.
* Multiplatform
  
  Available across different form factors, Wolvic can be adapted for your device. We support VR
  Glasses with passthrough and lightweight AR glasses.
* Open Source
  
  Wolvic is a free, secure and independent open source project, with versions using Gecko or
  Chromium, depending on your needs.

Device manufacturers & XR system builders

### Bring the Open Web in XR To Your Customers


Our first focus is on AOSP-based, stand-alone XR systems and HarmonyOS tethered systems, including:
* Huawei Vision Glass and VR Glass
* Magic Leap 2
* Oculus Quest 2, Quest Pro, Quest 3, and Quest 3S
* Pico Neo3, Pico4 and Pico4E
* Lynx R1

Look for the Wolvic in the [Huawei AppGallery][7], the [Oculus App store][8], and the [Pico
Store][9], or [you can get the APKs from our downloads page][10].

Want to see Wolvic in your device ecosystem? Contact us to discuss partnership opportunities and how
to enable Wolvic for your device or help us push the WebXR ecosystem forward.

[Contact Us][11]

## Latest from the blog
1. [Gecko Wolvic 1.9 and Chromium Wolvic 1.3 Released][12] Mon May 18 2026
2. [Gecko Wolvic 1.8.3 and Chromium Wolvic 1.2.3 Released][13] Wed Nov 26 2025
3. [Next Steps for Wolvic][14] Wed Nov 26 2025
4. [Gecko Wolvic 1.8.2 and Chromium Wolvic 1.2.2 Released][15] Thu Jun 12 2025
5. [Gecko Wolvic 1.8.1 and Chromium Wolvic 1.2.1 Released][16] Mon Feb 17 2025

[ View all posts][17]

Wolvic is developed by [Igalia][18]

Interested in joining [the pack][19]? Get in touch to talk about partnership opportunities.

[Contact Us][20]

## About Wolvic: Origins

Wolvic begins a new branch of the evolutionary tree of the Firefox Reality Browser. Firefox Reality
was an interesting and important development that began in Mozilla Research while XR devices were
still quite young.

Since then, more mature standalone devices have entered much wider consumer markets and the Firefox
Reality Browser project needed new investment, updates and nurturing. In 2022, Igalia took over
stewardship of this project and are calling the project “Wolvic”.

[screenshot of wolvic browser in Oculus Quest 2 with two browser windows, Igalia's website and a
video about Wolves on YouTube]

# X-R Trainer, Pilotes innovative training

#### [ Collaborative ][41]

Creation of a dedicated training platform, where any pilot who wishes to do so can connect at the
same time as other colleagues, will allow to faithfully recreate the working conditions in the
cockpit.
[ Read More ][42]

#### [ Customizable training ][43]

A solution based on eXtended Reality will allow you to train according to your needs through
specific e-learnings (aircraft systems, normal procedures, maneuvers & emergency procedures)
[ Read More ][44]

#### [ Autonomous system ][45]

These new training tools provide, in addition to their innovative technical characteristics, a new
way of training, independently of the difficult and expensive access to dynamic simulators.
[ Read More ][46]
The best safety device in any aircraft is a well-trained crew
Albert Lee Ueltschi

#### [ Collaborative ][41]

Creation of a dedicated training platform, where any pilot who wishes to do so can connect at the
same time as other colleagues, will allow to faithfully recreate the working conditions in the
cockpit.
[ Read More ][42]

#### [ Customizable training ][43]

A solution based on eXtended Reality will allow you to train according to your needs through
specific e-learnings (aircraft systems, normal procedures, maneuvers & emergency procedures)
[ Read More ][44]

#### [ Autonomous system ][45]

These new training tools provide, in addition to their innovative technical characteristics, a new
way of training, independently of the difficult and expensive access to dynamic simulators.
[ Read More ][46]

emissions thanks to working at home.
